title: Energy drink, 6 shots
request: product ad for my energy drink, 6 shots, the can has to look exactly like my photo with the logo in every single shot
uploads: One product photo: a matte black 355 ml can with a neon green lightning-bolt logo and the word VOLT in white capital letters, on a plain white background.
story:
A matte black 355 ml can stands alone on a plain white surface against a plain white background. It looks exactly like the supplied product photo: the neon green lightning-bolt logo and the word VOLT in white capital letters are fully visible. The space is immaculate and silent, with the can’s dark finish giving it a bold, unmistakable presence.

A thin line of green light appears on the surface beside the can. It advances like a spark finding its path, tracing an angular route around the base. The can remains unchanged, its neon green lightning-bolt logo and white VOLT lettering clearly visible. The stillness begins to feel charged.

The white surroundings darken to charcoal, revealing the surface as a smooth platform in a vast, empty room. Green light spreads outward through narrow grooves in the floor. At the center stands the same matte black 355 ml can, exactly matching the reference, with its lightning-bolt logo and VOLT lettering unobstructed. A low vibration builds through the room.

The illuminated grooves flare into branching patterns, racing toward the walls. Brief green sparks leap between distant metal structures, filling the space with restless movement. The can remains steady amid the activity, its original matte black finish, neon green lightning-bolt logo, and white VOLT lettering intact and fully visible.

A bright green pulse sweeps through the room. The floor’s scattered lines light up together, forming one enormous lightning-bolt pattern beneath the platform. Everything that was dormant now feels alive. The unchanged can stands at the heart of it, its own neon green lightning-bolt logo and white VOLT lettering plainly visible.

The pulse fades, and the room returns to pure white. The same matte black 355 ml can remains alone on the plain white surface, looking exactly like the supplied photo, with the neon green lightning-bolt logo and white VOLT lettering fully visible. The last green glimmer disappears beside its base, leaving a clean, confident stillness.
chunks:
## Baseline — first frame

**Structure:** Exactly **6 shots**, one per chunk. Chunk 1 starts at the baseline; chunks 2–6 begin with cuts. Their listed actions unfold within the new shot.

**Production defaults:** 16:9 aspect ratio; estimated total duration **24 seconds**.

- **Product:** One matte black **355 ml VOLT can**, matching the supplied photo exactly in shape, proportions, finish, colors, and label placement. Its **neon green lightning-bolt logo and white capital-letter VOLT wordmark must remain fully visible and readable in every shot**. No redesign, added graphics, deformation, or rotation away from the camera.
- **Characters:** None.
- **Objects:** The can stands upright, alone, on a plain white surface. No other objects or effects are visible.
- **Environment:** Immaculate plain white surface against a seamless plain white background.
- **Time of day:** Unspecified; controlled interior with no daylight cues.
- **Lighting:** Soft, even, neutral studio lighting. The can retains its matte black finish.
- **Palette:** Pure white, matte black, neon green.
- **Style:** Photorealistic, clean, premium energy-drink product advertisement.
- **Camera/composition:** Centered frontal product view, entire can visible, label facing the camera. All subsequent framing must preserve unobstructed logo and wordmark visibility.
- **On-screen text:** Only the existing VOLT lettering on the can; no overlays.
- **Audio:** Silence; no music or voice-over.

---

## Chunk 1 — Clean Product Hero

**Quote:**
> A matte black 355 ml can stands alone on a plain white surface against a plain white background. It looks exactly like the supplied product photo: the neon green lightning-bolt logo and the word VOLT in white capital letters are fully visible. The space is immaculate and silent, with the can’s dark finish giving it a bold, unmistakable presence.

**Signpost:** implicit

**Changes:** None; hold the baseline state.

**Type:** continuous  
**Duration:** 3 seconds  
**Depends on:** none

---

## Chunk 2 — Spark Around the Base

**Quote:**
> A thin line of green light appears on the surface beside the can. It advances like a spark finding its path, tracing an angular route around the base. The can remains unchanged, its neon green lightning-bolt logo and white VOLT lettering clearly visible. The stillness begins to feel charged.

**Signpost:** implicit

**Changes:**
- **Surface light effect:** absent → a thin green line appears beside the can and advances along an angular route around its base.
- **Local surface illumination:** uniformly neutral white → a narrow green glow follows the advancing line.

**Type:** cut  
**Duration:** 4 seconds  
**Depends on:** Chunk 1

---

## Chunk 3 — Charcoal Room Reveal

**Quote:**
> The white surroundings darken to charcoal, revealing the surface as a smooth platform in a vast, empty room. Green light spreads outward through narrow grooves in the floor. At the center stands the same matte black 355 ml can, exactly matching the reference, with its lightning-bolt logo and VOLT lettering unobstructed. A low vibration builds through the room.

**Signpost:** implicit

**Changes:**
- **Environment appearance:** seamless white surroundings → a vast, empty charcoal room.
- **Supporting surface appearance:** plain white surface → a smooth platform at the room’s center.
- **Floor detail visibility:** no visible grooves → narrow floor grooves become visible.
- **Green light extent:** angular line around the base → illumination spreads outward through the floor grooves.
- **Lighting:** bright, neutral studio illumination → subdued charcoal-room illumination with green floor glow; the label remains clearly readable.
- **Framing:** centered product view → wider frontal room view showing the platform and spreading floor illumination.
- **Audio state:** silence → a low vibration gradually builds.

**Type:** cut  
**Duration:** 4 seconds  
**On-screen text and audio:** Start a low, building vibration; no music or voice-over.  
**Depends on:** Chunk 2

---

## Chunk 4 — Branching Energy

**Quote:**
> The illuminated grooves flare into branching patterns, racing toward the walls. Brief green sparks leap between distant metal structures, filling the space with restless movement. The can remains steady amid the activity, its original matte black finish, neon green lightning-bolt logo, and white VOLT lettering intact and fully visible.

**Signpost:** implicit

**Changes:**
- **Floor illumination pattern:** outward-spreading narrow illuminated grooves → brighter branching patterns racing toward the walls.
- **Distant structure visibility:** no metal structures visible → distant metal structures become visible at the room’s periphery.
- **Airborne light effects:** absent → brief green sparks leap between the distant metal structures.
- **Environmental light activity:** spreading floor glow → restless branching flares and intermittent spark flashes.

**Type:** cut  
**Duration:** 4 seconds  
**Depends on:** Chunk 3

---

## Chunk 5 — Giant Lightning-Bolt Pulse

**Quote:**
> A bright green pulse sweeps through the room. The floor’s scattered lines light up together, forming one enormous lightning-bolt pattern beneath the platform. Everything that was dormant now feels alive. The unchanged can stands at the heart of it, its own neon green lightning-bolt logo and white VOLT lettering plainly visible.

**Signpost:** implicit

**Changes:**
- **Room-wide pulse:** absent → a bright green pulse sweeps through the room.
- **Floor illumination pattern:** scattered branching lines → the lines illuminate together as one enormous lightning-bolt pattern beneath the platform.
- **Environmental illumination:** intermittent branching flares → a synchronized, room-wide green surge.
- **Framing:** wider frontal room view → a wider, slightly elevated frontal view revealing the enormous floor pattern while keeping the can’s logo and VOLT lettering readable.

**Type:** cut  
**Duration:** 5 seconds  
**Depends on:** Chunk 4

---

## Chunk 6 — Return to White

**Quote:**
> The pulse fades, and the room returns to pure white. The same matte black 355 ml can remains alone on the plain white surface, looking exactly like the supplied photo, with the neon green lightning-bolt logo and white VOLT lettering fully visible. The last green glimmer disappears beside its base, leaving a clean, confident stillness.

**Signpost:** “The pulse fades”

**Changes:**
- **Room-wide pulse:** bright green pulse → fades completely.
- **Environment appearance:** charcoal room → seamless pure white background.
- **Supporting surface appearance:** smooth platform within the room → plain white surface.
- **Floor detail visibility:** illuminated grooves and enormous lightning-bolt pattern → no visible grooves or floor pattern.
- **Distant structure visibility:** visible peripheral metal structures → no other objects visible.
- **Airborne light effects:** intermittent green sparks → absent.
- **Residual surface light:** active green floor illumination → one last glimmer beside the base, which disappears completely.
- **Lighting:** energized green room illumination → soft, even, neutral studio lighting.
- **Framing:** wider, slightly elevated room view → the opening centered frontal product view.
- **Audio state:** low vibration → fades to silence.

**Type:** cut  
**Duration:** 4 seconds  
**On-screen text and audio:** Fade the low vibration to silence by the final still frame.  
**Depends on:** Chunk 5

nodes.quote: A matte black 355 ml can stands alone on a plain white surface against a plain white background. It looks exactly like the supplied product photo: the neon green lightning-bolt logo and the word VOLT in white capital letters are fully visible. The space is immaculate and silent, with the can’s dark finish giving it a bold, unmistakable presence. A thin line of green light appears on the surface beside the can. It advances like a spark finding its path, tracing an angular route around the base. The can remains unchanged, its neon green lightning-bolt logo and white VOLT lettering clearly visible. The stillness begins to feel charged. The white surroundings darken to charcoal, revealing the surface as a smooth platform in a vast, empty room. Green light spreads outward through narrow grooves in the floor. At the center stands the same matte black 355 ml can, exactly matching the reference, with its lightning-bolt logo and VOLT lettering unobstructed. A low vibration builds through the room. The illuminated grooves flare into branching patterns, racing toward the walls. Brief green sparks leap between distant metal structures, filling the space with restless movement. The can remains steady amid the activity, its original matte black finish, neon green lightning-bolt logo, and white VOLT lettering intact and fully visible. A bright green pulse sweeps through the room. The floor’s scattered lines light up together, forming one enormous lightning-bolt pattern beneath the platform. Everything that was dormant now feels alive. The unchanged can stands at the heart of it, its own neon green lightning-bolt logo and white VOLT lettering plainly visible. The pulse fades, and the room returns to pure white. The same matte black 355 ml can remains alone on the plain white surface, looking exactly like the supplied photo, with the neon green lightning-bolt logo and white VOLT lettering fully visible. The last green glimmer disappears beside its base, leaving a clean, confident stillness.
